0022600146.text: The Grizzlies (4-0, on a four-game winning streak and 3-0 on the road) visit the Trail Blazers (3-0, on a three-game streak) for their fifth game of the 2026-27 season. Memphis sits 2nd in the Southwest, half a game back, and 3rd in the West, while Portland leads the Northwest and is 2nd in the West. The teams have not met yet this season, and Portland is without Chris Youngblood (ankle soreness), Robert Williams III (knee) and Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery), all listed as out. Memphis lost the 2025-26 series 1-3, including a 122-114 loss in Memphis on March 4.
